Class DispatcherJSIMschema

java.lang.Object
simDispatcher.DispatcherJSIMschema
public class DispatcherJSIMschema extends Object
Receives the absolute path of a xml file which describes the model using the SIMmodeldefinition.xsd schema. The simulation results, at the end, are converted and are inserted in the original file.
Author:
Stefano Omini Modified by Bertoli Marco Modified by Francesco D'Aquino

    • checkSimProgress

      public double checkSimProgress()
      allows to know the state of simulation. Value is calculated at every refreshTempMeasures() to avoid pausing simulation two times.
      Returns:
      the percentage of progress (= number of computed confidence intervals / total number of required confidence intervals)

      public void forceFinished()
      Forces the simulation into the "finished" state without requiring it to have started. Called when the simulation failed to initialise (e.g. LoadException in SimLoader) so that threads polling isFinished() are unblocked.
